request.initial_prompt: If the element of spirit is naturally weak in him the change is speedily accomplished, but if he have a good deal, then the power of music weakening the spirit renders him excitable;—on the least provocation he flames up at once, and is speedily extinguished; instead of having spirit he grows irritable and passionate and is quite impracticable.

raw_segments.text: If the element of spirit is naturally weak in him the change is speedily accomplished,
but if he have a good deal then the power of music weakening the spirit renders him excitable.
On the least provocation he flames up at once and is speedily extinguished, instead of having
spirit he grows irritable and passionate and is quite impracticable.
